stemText: Why do elements of the 4d and 5d transition series belonging to the same vertical group possess nearly identical atomic radii (e.g., Zr ≈ 160 pm and Hf ≈ 159 pm)?

options.label: A
options.text: Due to Lanthanoid contraction (poor shielding by intervening 4f electrons)

options.label: C
options.text: Due to identical effective nuclear charges

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: In the 5d transition series, the filling of the 4f subshell precedes hafnium (Hf, Z = 72).
Step 2: The 4f electrons possess poor shielding capability due to their diffused spatial distribution.
Step 3: Consequently, the steady increase in nuclear charge pulls the valence electrons inward (Lanthanoid contraction).
Step 4: This size reduction completely compensates for the normal increase in radius down the group, making Zr and Hf almost identical in size (Option A).

translations.stemText: ஒரே செங்குத்துத் தொகுதியைச் சேர்ந்த 4d மற்றும் 5d இடைநிலைத் தனிமங்கள் ஒத்த அணு ஆரத்தைப் பெற்றிருப்பதன் (எ.கா., Zr ≈ Hf) காரணம் என்ன?
optionTexts: லாந்தனைடு குறுக்கம் காரணமாக (4f எலக்ட்ரான்களின் பலவீன மறைப்பு விளைவு)

stemText: Among the 3d transition series elements, which metal exhibits the maximum number of oxidation states?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Oxidation state variability in transition metals depends on the availability of electrons in both (n-1)d and ns subshells.
Step 2: Manganese has the valence configuration 3d5 4s2 with 5 unpaired d-electrons and 2 s-electrons.
Step 3: By participating sequentially, manganese displays all oxidation states from +2 up to +7 (e.g. in KMnO4).
Step 4: Conclude Manganese (Option A) exhibits the maximum oxidation states in the 3d series.

translations.stemText: 3d இடைநிலைத் தொடர் தனிமங்களில், அதிக எண்ணிக்கையிலான ஆக்சிஜனேற்ற நிலைகளைக் காட்டும் உலோகம் எது?

stemText: In the 3d transition series, only copper has a positive standard electrode potential (E°_Cu2+/Cu = +0.34 V). This positive value is due to:

options.label: A
options.text: High enthalpy of atomization and high ionization enthalpy of copper not being balanced by its hydration enthalpy

options.label: B
options.text: Copper having an exceptionally high hydration enthalpy

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: The standard electrode potential E° relates to Delta H_total = Delta_a H° + Delta_i H°1 + Delta_i H°2 + Delta_hyd H°.
Step 2: Copper has an exceptionally high enthalpy of atomization and high second ionization enthalpy (removing an electron from stable 3d10).
Step 3: The hydration enthalpy of Cu2+ is not sufficiently negative to compensate for these large energy inputs.
Step 4: As a result, the conversion Cu(s) -> Cu2+(aq) is endothermic and E°_Cu2+/Cu is positive (+0.34 V). Conclude Option A.

translations.stemText: 3d தொடரில் தாமிரம் மட்டுமே நேர்மறை திட்ட மின்முனை அழுத்தத்தைக் (E°_Cu2+/Cu = +0.34 V) கொண்டிருப்பதன் காரணம் என்ன?
optionTexts: அதிக அணுவாக்கல் மற்றும் அயனியாக்கும் என்தால்பியை அதன் நீரேற்ற என்தால்பியால் ஈடுசெய்ய முடியாதது

stemText: In aqueous solution, Cu2+ is more stable than Cu+ because:

options.label: A
options.text: The much more negative hydration enthalpy of Cu2+ overcomes its high second ionization enthalpy

options.label: B
options.text: Cu2+ has a fully filled 3d10 configuration

options.label: D
options.text: Cu2+ has a lower charge density than Cu+

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Although Cu+ has a stable 3d10 configuration, in aqueous solution it disproportionates: 2 Cu+ -> Cu2+ + Cu.
Step 2: Cu2+ has a smaller ionic radius and double the charge of Cu+, resulting in a much higher charge density.
Step 3: The hydration enthalpy of Cu2+ is vastly more negative (exothermic) than that of Cu+, more than compensating for the second ionization energy of copper.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: நீர்க்கரைசலில் Cu+ ஐ விட Cu2+ அதிக நிலைப்புத்தன்மை கொண்டிருப்பதன் காரணம் என்ன?
optionTexts: Cu2+ அயனியின் அதிக நீரேற்ற என்தால்பி அதன் இரண்டாவது அயனியாக்கும் ஆற்றலை ஈடுசெய்கிறது
Cu2+ அயனி Cu+ ஐ விட குறைந்த மின்சுமை அடர்த்தி கொண்டது

stemText: What is the spin-only magnetic moment of a divalent ion of an element with atomic number 27 (Co2+)?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Atomic number Z = 27 is Cobalt (Co). Configuration: [Ar] 3d7 4s2.
Step 2: Divalent cation Co2+ = [Ar] 3d7.
Step 3: In a 3d7 subshell, there are 3 unpaired electrons (n = 3).
Step 4: Spin-only magnetic moment mu = sqrt(n(n+2)) = sqrt(3(5)) = sqrt(15) = 3.87 BM (Option A).

translations.stemText: அணு எண் 27 கொண்ட தனிமத்தின் இருஇணைதிறன் அயனியின் (Co2+) தற்சுழற்சி மட்டுமேயான காந்தத் திருப்புத்திறன் என்ன?

stemText: Which of the following transition metal ions is colorless in aqueous solution?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Transition metal ions are colored in aqueous solution due to d-d transitions, which require partially filled d-orbitals (d1 to d9).
Step 2: Scandium (Z = 21) configuration: [Ar] 3d1 4s2. Sc3+ = [Ar] 3d0.
Step 3: Since Sc3+ has an empty d-subshell (d0), no d-d transition is possible.
Step 4: Hence, Sc3+ is completely colorless (Option A).

translations.stemText: நீர்க்கரைசலில் நிறமற்றதாக இருக்கும் இடைநிலை உலோக அயனி எது?

stemText: Potassium permanganate (KMnO4) exhibits an intense dark purple color despite manganese having a d0 electronic configuration in Mn(VII). This intense color is due to:

options.label: A
options.text: Charge transfer from oxygen (ligand) to manganese (metal) [L -> M charge transfer]

options.label: C
options.text: Presence of unpaired electrons in 4s orbital

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: In KMnO4, Mn is in the +7 oxidation state with an empty 3d0 configuration; therefore, d-d transitions cannot occur.
Step 2: Absorption of visible light occurs via a Ligand-to-Metal Charge Transfer (LMCT) mechanism.
Step 3: An electron is momentarily transferred from the filled 2p molecular orbital of oxygen (O2-) to the empty 3d orbital of Mn(VII).
Step 4: This Laporte-allowed charge transfer produces the intense purple color (Option A).

translations.stemText: KMnO4 இல் மாங்கனீசு d0 எலக்ட்ரான் அமைப்பைப் பெற்றிருந்த போதிலும், அடர் ஊதா நிறத்தைக் கொண்டிருப்பதன் காரணம் என்ன?
optionTexts: ஆக்ஸிஜனிலிருந்து மாங்கனீசுக்கு நிகழும் மின்சுமை இடமாற்றம் (L -> M charge transfer)

stemText: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic property of interstitial compounds formed by transition metals?

options.label: A
options.text: They are chemically very reactive compared to pure metals

options.label: B
options.text: They have high melting points, higher than those of pure metals

options.label: C
options.text: They are extremely hard, some approaching diamond in hardness

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Interstitial compounds are formed when small non-metal atoms (H, C, N) are trapped in voids of transition metal lattices.
Step 2: They are non-stoichiometric, extremely hard, have very high melting points, and retain metallic electrical conductivity.
Step 3: They are chemically inert (unreactive), not chemically reactive.
Step 4: Statement A is false and therefore the correct option.

translations.stemText: இடைநிலை உலோகங்கள் உருவாக்கும் இடைச்செருகல் சேர்மங்களின் (Interstitial compounds) தவறான பண்பு எது?
optionTexts: அவை தூய உலோகங்களை விட அதிக வேதி வினைதிறன் கொண்டவை
அவை தூய உலோகங்களை விட அதிக உருகுநிலையைக் கொண்டுள்ளன
அவை வைரத்தைப் போன்ற மிக அதிக கடினத்தன்மை கொண்டவை
அவை உலோகக் கடத்துத்திறனைத் தக்க வைத்துக் கொள்கின்றன

stemText: In the industrial preparation of potassium dichromate (K2Cr2O7) from chromite ore (FeCr2O4), the initial fusion with sodium carbonate in the presence of air yields:

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: The roasting of chromite ore with sodium carbonate in excess air: 4 FeCr2O4 + 8 Na2CO3 + 7 O2 -> 8 Na2CrO4 + 2 Fe2O3 + 8 CO2.
Step 2: The yellow solution of sodium chromate (Na2CrO4) is filtered and acidified with H2SO4 to yield orange sodium dichromate.
Step 3: Treatment of sodium dichromate with KCl crystallizes out potassium dichromate (K2Cr2O7).
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: குரோமைட் தாதுவிலிருந்து (FeCr2O4) பொட்டாசியம் டைகுரோமேட் தயாரிப்பில், காற்று முன்னிலையில் சோடியம் கார்பனேட்டுடன் உருக்கும் போது கிடைப்பது எது?

stemText: In aqueous solution, chromate ion (CrO4^2-, yellow) and dichromate ion (Cr2O7^2-, orange) interconvert depending on pH. What is the oxidation state of chromium in CrO4^2- and Cr2O7^2-, respectively?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: In CrO4^2-: x + 4(-2) = -2 => x = +6.
Step 2: In Cr2O7^2-: 2x + 7(-2) = -2 => 2x = 12 => x = +6.
Step 3: The interconversion 2 CrO4^2- + 2 H+ <=> Cr2O7^2- + H2O is an acid-base equilibrium, not a redox reaction.
Step 4: The oxidation state of chromium is +6 in both species (Option A).

translations.stemText: CrO4^2- (மஞ்சள்) மற்றும் Cr2O7^2- (ஆரஞ்சு) அயனிகளில் குரோமியத்தின் ஆக்சிஜனேற்ற எண்கள் முறையே:

stemText: In the dichromate dianion (Cr2O7^2-), what is the structural nature of the chromium-oxygen bonds?

options.label: A
options.text: Six equivalent terminal Cr-O bonds and two bridge Cr-O-Cr bonds with a bond angle of 126°

options.label: B
options.text: All seven Cr-O bonds are identical in length

options.label: C
options.text: The Cr-O-Cr bridge bond angle is 180° (linear)

options.label: D
options.text: It consists of planar CrO3 units

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: The structure of Cr2O7^2- consists of two tetrahedral CrO4 units sharing a single oxygen atom at a corner.
Step 2: The six terminal Cr-O bonds have identical lengths (163 pm) due to resonance delocalization.
Step 3: The bridging Cr-O-Cr bond length is longer (179 pm) with a bent bridge angle of 126°.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: டைகுரோமேட் எதிரயனியில் (Cr2O7^2-) குரோமியம்-ஆக்ஸிஜன் பிணைப்புகளின் அமைப்பு எவ்வாறு உள்ளது?
optionTexts: ஆறு சமமான முனைய Cr-O பிணைப்புகள் மற்றும் 126° பிணைப்புக் கோணம் கொண்ட இரண்டு பால Cr-O-Cr பிணைப்புகள்
அனைத்து ஏழு Cr-O பிணைப்புகளும் ஒரே நீளம் கொண்டவை

stemText: How many moles of electrons are involved when 1 mole of potassium dichromate (K2Cr2O7) acts as an oxidizing agent in acidic medium?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Ionic half-reaction in acidic medium: Cr2O7^2- + 14 H+ + 6 e- -> 2 Cr3+ + 7 H2O.
Step 2: Two chromium atoms change from +6 to +3, each accepting 3 electrons.
Step 3: Total electrons gained per mole of Cr2O7^2- is 2 * 3 = 6 electrons (n-factor = 6).
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: அமில ஊடகத்தில் 1 மோல் பொட்டாசியம் டைகுரோமேட் (K2Cr2O7) ஆக்சிஜனேற்றியாக செயல்படும் போது எத்தனை மோல் எலக்ட்ரான்கள் ஏற்கப்படுகின்றன?

stemText: Pyrolusite ore (MnO2) is converted into potassium permanganate by first fusing with KOH in the presence of air to form a green compound 'X'. Compound 'X' is:

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Fusion of MnO2 with caustic potash (KOH) in the presence of atmospheric oxygen or an oxidizing agent like KNO3: 2 MnO2 + 4 KOH + O2 -> 2 K2MnO4 + 2 H2O.
Step 2: The product is potassium manganate (K2MnO4), which is dark green.
Step 3: Disproportionation or electrolytic oxidation of manganate (MnO4^2-) then yields purple permanganate (KMnO4).
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: பைரோலுசைட் தாது (MnO2) காற்று முன்னிலையில் KOH உடன் உருகும்போது உருவாகும் பச்சை நிற சேர்மம் 'X' எது?

stemText: In neutral or faintly alkaline medium, KMnO4 oxidizes potassium iodide (KI) quantitatively into:

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: In acidic medium, permanganate oxidizes iodide (I-) to iodine (I2): 2 MnO4^- + 16 H+ + 10 I- -> 2 Mn2+ + 5 I2 + 8 H2O.
Step 2: In neutral or faintly alkaline medium, permanganate oxidizes iodide directly to iodate (IO3-): 2 MnO4^- + H2O + I- -> 2 MnO2 + 2 OH^- + IO3^-.
Step 3: Iodate is KIO3.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: நடுநிலை அல்லது கார ஊடகத்தில், KMnO4 பொட்டாசியம் அயோடைடை (KI) எவ்வாறு ஆக்சிஜனேற்றம் செய்கிறது?

stemText: The equivalent weight of potassium permanganate (molar mass = M) when acting as an oxidizing agent in acidic solution is:

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Half-reaction in acidic medium: MnO4^- + 8 H+ + 5 e- -> Mn2+ + 4 H2O.
Step 2: Oxidation state of Mn changes from +7 to +2, gaining 5 electrons (n-factor = 5).
Step 3: Equivalent weight = Molar mass / n-factor = M / 5.
Step 4: (In neutral medium, n-factor is 3 -> M/3; in strongly alkaline, n-factor is 1 -> M/1). Conclude Option A.

translations.stemText: அமிலக் கரைசலில் பொட்டாசியம் பெர்மாங்கனேட்டின் (மோலார் நிறை = M) சமான நிறை என்ன?

stemText: In the chromyl chloride test for chloride ions, heating solid chloride with K2Cr2O7 and concentrated H2SO4 evolves deep red vapors of:

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Solid ionic chloride reacts with potassium dichromate and conc. H2SO4: 4 NaCl + K2Cr2O7 + 6 H2SO4 -> 2 CrO2Cl2(g) + 2 KHSO4 + 4 NaHSO4 + 3 H2O.
Step 2: The deep red vapors evolved are chromyl chloride (CrO2Cl2).
Step 3: When passed into NaOH solution, it forms yellow Na2CrO4, confirmed by lead acetate giving yellow PbCrO4 precipitate.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: குளோரைடு அயனிகளுக்கான குரோமைல் குளோரைடு சோதனையில், திட குளோரைடை K2Cr2O7 மற்றும் அடர் H2SO4 உடன் சூடுபடுத்தும்போது வெளியாகும் அடர் சிவப்பு நிற ஆவி எது?

stemText: Which of the following is the most common and stable oxidation state exhibited by all lanthanoids?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: The general valence shell configuration of lanthanoids is 4f^(1-14) 5d^(0-1) 6s^2.
Step 2: All lanthanoids readily lose their two 6s electrons and one 5d (or 4f) electron.
Step 3: The +3 oxidation state is predominantly stable across the entire 4f series in both solid state and aqueous solutions.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: அனைத்து லாந்தனைடுகளாலும் பொதுவாகக் காட்டப்படும் மிகவும் நிலையான முதன்மை ஆக்சிஜனேற்ற நிலை எது?

stemText: Cerium (Z = 58) exhibits a stable +4 oxidation state (Ce4+) because:

options.label: A
options.text: It attains the stable noble gas electronic configuration of xenon ([Xe] 4f0)

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Electronic configuration of neutral Cerium (Z = 58): [Xe] 4f1 5d1 6s2.
Step 2: By losing four electrons (two 6s, one 5d, one 4f), Ce4+ attains the noble gas configuration of Xenon ([Xe] 4f0).
Step 3: This empty f-subshell confers exceptional thermodynamic stability, making Ce(IV) a well-known analytical oxidizing agent.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: சீரியம் (Z = 58) நிலையான +4 ஆக்சிஜனேற்ற நிலையைக் (Ce4+) காட்டுவதற்கான காரணம் என்ன?
optionTexts: இது செனானின் நிலையான மந்த வாயு எலக்ட்ரான் அமைப்பைப் ([Xe] 4f0) பெறுகிறது

stemText: Europium(II) (Eu2+, Z = 63) is a strong reducing agent in aqueous solution because:

options.label: A
options.text: It readily oxidizes to the more stable +3 state (Eu3+) which is the dominant state for lanthanoids

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Eu2+ has the half-filled configuration [Xe] 4f7.
Step 2: However, for all lanthanoids, the +3 oxidation state is thermodynamically the most stable in aqueous solution.
Step 3: Hence, Eu2+ has a strong propensity to lose one electron to form Eu3+, acting as a powerful reducing agent.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: நீர்க்கரைசலில் யூரோப்பியம்(II) (Eu2+, Z = 63) ஒரு வலிமையான ஒடுக்கும் காரணியாகச் செயல்படுவதன் காரணம் என்ன?
optionTexts: இது லாந்தனைடுகளின் மிகவும் நிலையான +3 நிலைக்கு (Eu3+) எளிதில் ஆக்சிஜனேற்றம் அடைகிறது
இது முழுமையாக நிரப்பப்பட்ட 4f14 துணைக் கூட்டைக் கொண்டுள்ளது

stemText: As a consequence of the Lanthanoid contraction, the basic strength of the lanthanoid hydroxides Ln(OH)3 from La(OH)3 to Lu(OH)3:

options.label: A
options.text: Decreases progressively (La(OH)3 is most basic, Lu(OH)3 is least basic)

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Across the lanthanoid series from La3+ to Lu3+, ionic radius decreases steadily due to lanthanoid contraction.
Step 2: According to Fajans' rules, a smaller cation polarizes the hydroxide (OH-) ion more effectively, increasing covalent character of the Ln-OH bond.
Step 3: Increasing covalent character reduces cleavage of the O-H bond to release OH- ions in water.
Step 4: Therefore, basic strength decreases from La(OH)3 to Lu(OH)3 (Option A).

translations.stemText: லாந்தனைடு குறுக்கத்தின் காரணமாக, La(OH)3 முதல் Lu(OH)3 வரை உள்ள லாந்தனைடு ஹைட்ராக்சைடுகளின் கார வலிமை:
optionTexts: தொடர்ந்து குறைகிறது (La(OH)3 அதிக காரத்தன்மை, Lu(OH)3 குறைந்த காரத்தன்மை)

stemText: Mischmetal is a commercially important pyrophoric alloy consisting primarily of:

options.label: A
options.text: ~95% Lanthanoid metals (chiefly Ce and La) and ~5% Iron, with traces of S, C, Ca, and Al

options.label: C
options.text: Copper and Zinc with traces of Nickel

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Mischmetal is an alloy consisting of rare earth (lanthanoid) metals (~95%, particularly ~50% cerium, ~40% lanthanum and neodymium) and ~5% iron.
Step 2: Traces of sulfur, carbon, calcium, and aluminum are present as impurities.
Step 3: It produces hot sparks when struck and is used in cigarette lighters, flintlock ignition devices, and tracer bullets.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

stemText: Actinoids exhibit a much greater range of oxidation states (such as +3, +4, +5, +6, and +7 in U, Np, Pu) than lanthanoids because:

options.label: A
options.text: The energy gap between 5f, 6d, and 7s subshells in actinoids is very small, allowing electrons from all three to participate

options.label: C
options.text: 5f electrons have greater shielding effect than 4f electrons

options.label: D
options.text: Actinoids have higher ionization energies than lanthanoids

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: In lanthanoids, the 4f subshell is buried deep inside the core and has much lower energy than 5d and 6s, restricting participation mainly to +3.
Step 2: In actinoids, the energy levels of 5f, 6d, and 7s are comparable in energy.
Step 3: Consequently, electrons from 5f, 6d, and 7s can all take part in bond formation, generating high oxidation states up to +7.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: லாந்தனைடுகளை விட ஆக்டினைடுகள் அதிக அளவிலான ஆக்சிஜனேற்ற நிலைகளைக் (+3, +4, +5, +6, +7) காட்டுவதன் காரணம் என்ன?
optionTexts: 5f, 6d, மற்றும் 7s துணைக் கூடுகளுக்கு இடையேயான ஆற்றல் வேறுபாடு மிகக் குறைவு என்பதால்
ஆக்டினைடுகள் அனைத்தும் கதிரியக்கத் தன்மை கொண்டவை என்பதால்

stemText: The actinoid contraction from element to element is greater than the lanthanoid contraction because:

options.label: A
options.text: 5f orbitals have poorer shielding effect than 4f orbitals

options.label: B
options.text: 5f orbitals are more spherical than 4f orbitals

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: The 5f electrons extend further from the nucleus into space than 4f electrons.
Step 2: Because 5f orbitals are more diffuse, their shielding power against the nuclear charge is even poorer than that of 4f electrons.
Step 3: Consequently, the effective nuclear charge experienced across the 5f series increases more rapidly.
Step 4: This produces an actinoid contraction that is greater than the lanthanoid contraction (Option A).

translations.stemText: லாந்தனைடு குறுக்கத்தை விட ஆக்டினைடு குறுக்கம் அதிகமாக இருப்பதன் காரணம் என்ன?
optionTexts: 4f ஆர்பிட்டால்களை விட 5f ஆர்பிட்டால்கள் குறைந்த மறைப்பு விளைவைக் கொண்டுள்ளன
5f ஆர்பிட்டால்கள் 4f ஐ விட அதிக கோள வடிவம் கொண்டவை

stemText: Zinc, Cadmium, and Mercury are placed in Group 12 of the periodic table but are NOT regarded as typical transition elements because:

options.label: A
options.text: They have completely filled (d10) subshells in their ground states as well as in their common oxidation states

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: IUPAC defines a transition element as an element whose atom has a partially filled d subshell, or which can give rise to cations with an incomplete d subshell.
Step 2: Zn, Cd, and Hg have full (n-1)d10 ns2 ground state configurations.
Step 3: In their common oxidation state (+2), they lose two s-electrons, retaining a completely filled (n-1)d10 subshell (e.g. Zn2+ = [Ar] 3d10).
Step 4: Lacking partially filled d-orbitals, they do not show typical transition properties (Option A).

optionTexts: அவை அவற்றின் அடிநிலை மற்றும் பொதுவான ஆக்சிஜனேற்ற நிலைகளில் முழுமையாக நிரப்பப்பட்ட (d10) துணைக் கூட்டைக் கொண்டுள்ளன

stemText: In acidic solution, green manganate ion (MnO4^2-) is unstable and spontaneously disproportionates to form:

options.label: A
options.text: Purple permanganate ion (MnO4^-) and brown manganese dioxide (MnO2)

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: The manganate(VI) ion (MnO4^2-) is stable only in strongly alkaline solution (pH > 12).
Step 2: In neutral or acidic solutions, it undergoes disproportionation: 3 MnO4^2- + 4 H+ -> 2 MnO4^- + MnO2 + 2 H2O.
Step 3: Manganese(+6) is simultaneously oxidized to manganese(+7) (MnO4^-, purple) and reduced to manganese(+4) (MnO2, brown).
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

optionTexts: ஊதா நிற பெர்மாங்கனேட் (MnO4^-) மற்றும் பழுப்பு நிற மாங்கனீசு டை ஆக்சைடு (MnO2)

stemText: Among the oxides of chromium: CrO, Cr2O3, and CrO3, what is the nature of their acid-base character in increasing order of oxidation state?

options.label: A
options.text: CrO is basic, Cr2O3 is amphoteric, and CrO3 is acidic

options.label: B
options.text: CrO is acidic, Cr2O3 is amphoteric, and CrO3 is basic

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: The oxidation states of chromium are +2 (in CrO), +3 (in Cr2O3), and +6 (in CrO3).
Step 2: In lower oxidation states (+2), the oxide has predominantly ionic character and acts as a basic oxide (CrO is basic).
Step 3: In intermediate states (+3), the oxide displays amphoteric properties (Cr2O3 dissolves in both acids and bases).
Step 4: In higher oxidation states (+6), covalent character dominates due to strong polarization, making CrO3 an acidic oxide (forms H2CrO4 in water). Conclude Option A.

optionTexts: CrO காரத்தன்மை, Cr2O3 ஈரியல்புத்தன்மை, மற்றும் CrO3 அமிலத்தன்மை

stemText: Which transition metal in the 3d series has the highest melting point?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: The melting point of transition metals depends directly on the strength of metallic bonding.
Step 2: Metallic bonding strength increases with the number of unpaired d-electrons available for interatomic bonding.
Step 3: Chromium has the maximum number of unpaired electrons (3d5 4s1 = 6 unpaired electrons) in the 3d series.
Step 4: Hence, chromium possesses the strongest metallic bonding and highest melting point (~1907 °C) in the 3d series (Option A).

translations.stemText: 3d இடைநிலைத் தொடரில் மிக அதிக உருகுநிலையைக் கொண்டுள்ள உலோகம் எது?

stemText: Alloy formation is very common among transition metals because:

options.label: A
options.text: Their atomic sizes are very similar (within 15%), allowing mutual substitution in the crystal lattice

options.label: B
options.text: They all have the same density

options.label: C
options.text: They react violently with each other

options.label: D
options.text: Their electronegativity values are identical to alkali metals

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Alloys are homogeneous solid solutions where atoms of one metal are distributed randomly among the atoms of another.
Step 2: According to the Hume-Rothery rules, solid solubility is favored when the atomic radii of the two metals differ by no more than ~15%.
Step 3: Transition metals of similar series have almost identical radii, allowing one metal atom to readily substitute for another in the metallic crystal lattice.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

stemText: What is the highest oxidation state exhibited by any transition metal in the periodic table?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: While the maximum oxidation state in the 3d series is +7 (in Mn), heavier transition metals can achieve higher states.
Step 2: Ruthenium (Ru) and Osmium (Os) of Group 8 utilize all their valence d and s electrons to form tetroxides: RuO4 and OsO4.
Step 3: In OsO4 and RuO4, the metal exhibits the formal +8 oxidation state.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

stemText: Which of the following lanthanoid ions is diamagnetic in its ground state?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: A species is diamagnetic when all its electrons are paired (zero unpaired electrons, n = 0).
Step 2: Lutetium (Lu, Z = 71) has configuration [Xe] 4f14 5d1 6s2. Lu3+ = [Xe] 4f14.
Step 3: The 4f subshell is completely filled with 14 paired electrons, meaning zero unpaired electrons.
Step 4: Therefore, Lu3+ (and La3+ with 4f0) is diamagnetic. Conclude Option A is correct.
